why: a hand-edited file under apps/mobile/ios or apps/mobile/android: the next `expo prebuild` deletes the edit without saying so, and a config-plugin change can no longer be told apart from drift

input.falsifyingEdit: commit a single file under apps/mobile/ios/
input.secondHalf: two `expo prebuild --clean` runs on one commit disagreeing beyond a consistent renaming of Xcode object ids

mustNotBe: a tracked file under either native directory, or two prebuilds whose canonicalised trees differ. Repo-state falsifier; the CI job is prebuild-determinism in native-e2e.yml.
addedNote: Added at P1 integration: the id was owned by a green test and had no committed falsifying input.
